entry_points.summary: Per-PPID sentinel caches CODEX_SUPPORTS_OUTFILE; greps `codex exec --help` for `output-last-message`; runs once per orchestrating process
Codex dispatch appends -o OUTFILE; stdout transcript discarded; fallback on empty/missing file emits review_capture_fallback
Uniform schema {id, cycle, role, reason} across all three agents; role disambiguates for fallback-rate cut
Emitted before CLI call; liveness.sh uses as in-flight marker; matching end is consult event in Archiving section

invariants: non-codex provider path is byte-identical to pre-feature; -o is only appended when provider==codex
capability probe runs at most once per PPID process; sentinel keyed on PPID not $$
reviewer OUTFILE always in $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR/archive/tasks/<id>/; path never needs external discovery
fallback always emits review_capture_fallback before reverting to stdout; verdict is never silently dropped
response_chars = size of the captured final review (honest), not the discarded transcript
all three agents share the same probe/dispatch/fallback/log shape; co-maintained
reviewer expected_contract=review-verdict; both consultants expected_contract=freeform; persona binding validated by resolve-persona.py
reviewer INTENT mode requires both intent_snapshot: AND ledger_path:; exactly one present => BLOCKED verdict with MISCONFIGURED message
minors/nits dropped from reviewer return sections; MUST appear in FOLLOWUPS fenced JSON block (P3/P2) routed via parse-followups-block.py
consult_start emitted BEFORE the CLI call (not after); consult event is the matching end-marker for liveness.sh
gotchas: sentinel keyed on $PPID (parent PID) not $$; each bash invocation is a new process so $$ always differs
if $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR is unset, ARCHIVE_DIR construction fails before dispatch — orchestrator must export it
codex non-zero exit triggers fallback even if $OUTFILE was partially written; file considered valid only on exit 0
probe greps for long-form --output-last-message but dispatches with short alias -o; future rename will probe-fail and fall through safely
review-cycle<N>.md is overwritten on cycle number reuse; callers should not assume uniqueness across retries
review_capture_fallback uniform schema: {id, cycle, role, reason}; role is cross-agent disambiguator (not just reviewer)
consultant archive paths differ from reviewer: z-harness/archive/$RUN/transcripts/ vs $Z_HARNESS_PLAN_DIR/archive/tasks/<id>/
reviewer reads relevant_docs (docs/llm/<concept>.json paths) BEFORE composing review prompt — omitting them can cause missed contract drift findings
